review_method: Actual PNG pixels opened and personally inspected, not inferred from code or filenames.
findings: Old exposed sphere cores and wide radial triangular spikes are absent.
Final close view shows layered thin tapered foliage, varied interior spray bearings and curved/sideways tips; lower woody stems remain intentionally visible.
Dense foliage no longer displays the black wedges seen in rejected draft renders; sufficient transparent ray depth was used for masked leaves.
Oblique whole-surround view shows six shrubs and no obvious flat opaque card crosses or disappearing lobes in this static camera.
Existing stone, rail, soil, rocks and small panel housings stay in their original positions and match the separate geometry/material/transform hash checks.
The final whole-surround preview excludes statue, large trees and other scene models. It is not a full-application screenshot.

render_controls.camera_and_lighting: Same for each before/after matched view.
render_controls.preview_floor: Neutral staging plane, not exported in either GLB.
render_controls.comparison_assembly: Unmodified render pixels placed beside each other with labels; no visual retouching.

rejected_versions: High triangle all-geometry exploratory draft was not selected.
Sparse masked foliage draft was rejected for exposed scaffold-like branches.
Over-coherent dense spray draft and insufficient transparent-ray-depth images were rejected.
limitations: Not a botanical identification or site survey.
No full Three.js app integration, moving-camera mip/shimmer test, FPS measurement or walking test was performed.
One frontal close view and one oblique mid-distance view were accepted; no claim of exhaustive every-angle coverage.
Original baseline was regenerated from pinned source and recorded terrain contacts, not fetched as the original GLB binary.
